system_prompt_style.note: Prompt construction code is not included in the evidence. The attached arXiv papers (2407.15073 causal discovery, 2412.05449 AWS) describe different systems that share the MAC acronym and were not used.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The Spec Planner reads only the user request; the Architect reads only `CADBrief`; the Coder reads only `ArchitectPlan`; Aider reads only the QA error report + `build123d_reference.md`.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value. Stages receive structured state rather than environment context. Aider also gets a static reference doc.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Agents pass only compact structured states (`CADBrief`, `ArchitectPlan`, QA reports) instead of raw conversation
context_compaction.note: There is no history compaction as such. Structured handoff replaces history between stages.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Aider reads only the QA error report + `build123d_reference.md`
observation_format.note: Measurements are also written as JSON (temp_measurements_*.json).

tool_call_format.note: Stages emit JSON and code, and Aider does the repair. The parser is not shown.

edit_primitive.note: Aider performs the edits, but the edit format is not stated.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: splits the generation process into 4 agents wired together by a LangGraph state machine
loop_primitives.note: The Stage 4 QA plus Aider repair loop is generate_test_repair (QA closed-loop, MAX_RETRIES=5, per docs/quantified_quality.md).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Each agent's input is the previous stage's structured JSON output (`CADBrief`, `ArchitectPlan`), not a re-stuffed transcript.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: splits the generation process into 4 agents wired together by a LangGraph state machine

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the output of one stage becomes the input of the next
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value. This is a fixed pipeline handoff via structured JSON.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Each QA pass opens a 10-second checkpoint (auto-iterates on timeout): press `1` auto-iterate, `2` inject change requirements, `3` halt and keep current artifacts.
human_in_loop.note: Closest value. This is a terminal-only QA-iteration checkpoint that auto-continues on timeout. The Web UI has no checkpoint.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: For the complete pipeline diagrams (Mermaid), GraphState definition, per-stage design rationale

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: `pipeline_cache/` stores the output of the first two stages, saving time and money on re-runs
long_term_memory.note: Closest value. This is a cross-run cache of stage outputs, not memory proper.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: the cache is hit, the first two LLM stages are skipped, and the pipeline restarts at the Python Coder stage with a fresh repair loop

self_verification.evidence_quote: Even though MAC's QA closed-loop detected the failure and repeatedly fed it to Aider for repair
self_verification.note: Harness-run geometric QA (Dual-Engine QA, measurements), not unit tests.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: exceeds the system's maximum auto-repair iteration limit (MAX_RETRIES=5)
retry_policy.note: The retries are repair iterations until QA passes, capped at 5. A re-run with the cache gives a new attempt manually.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: exceeds the system's maximum auto-repair iteration limit (MAX_RETRIES=5) and is let through
termination_condition.note: The loop ends on QA pass or at the retry cap. A user halt (option 3) is also available in the terminal.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: each stage can pick its own model
cost_controls.note: Routing is static per stage via config. Caching means pipeline_cache stage outputs. No prompt cache_control is used.

execution_isolation.note: No container is mentioned. Execution happens on the host.

tracing.evidence_quote: every intermediate artifact (`CADBrief`, `ArchitectPlan`, `temp_design.py`, `temp_measurements_*.json`, `temp_missed_*.json`, QA report) is serialized to disk and human-auditable
tracing.note: LangGraph events are also streamed to the terminal.

eval_hooks.note: The benchmark results are reported, but no evaluation runner is shown.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A decoupled multi-agent framework for text-to-CAD generation via constrained test-time compute
target_domain.note: The domain is text-to-CAD, which generates code but is not repository SWE.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Point two config fields at any provider
model_agnostic.note: Uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The Aider stage uses litellm.

primary_artifact.note: No paper. The attached arXiv papers concern unrelated systems also named MAC.

first_release_date.note: The date is that of the only tag in the evidence. The first tag and first commit are unknown.
